steps.content: [Town center]
The small square in front of the inn is the last safe zone Vautour Bleu has created, fortified by the datura flowers. There, she stands in its center, encircled by a seething crowd of townsfolk.
The once familiar faces now regard her with confusion, bewilderment, and burning anger.

Just let them pour out all their hatred on her. After all, no one's better than a Sinner to suffer all the Mania, to bear the burden of their pain. That is the very reason her power exists—to save these shattered dreams.

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: It was all a lie, wasn't it? We're never going to DisCity, aren't we?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Oh, you naive child. Are you only figuring it out now? What took you so long?

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: You promised to clear our records and said we could start a new life in DisCity...

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Has it never crossed your mind that this might be too good to be true? Or, perhaps you've been overestimating me—or underestimating DisCity's border police?
Vautour Bleu's expression remains unflappable as she faces the barrage of accusations, her voice calm. Her gaze, steady and indifferent, falls on Zindy, who crumples to the ground devastated.
[Dark alley]
Meanwhile, around you, new monsters begin spawning in the corners uncovered by datura flowers, croaking their resentment for the lie of Désir.
Vautour Bleu's words echoes in your mind, in an inaptly casual tone: "We'll purge them all in the end anyway. Just let the monsters come to me."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The more monsters there are, it means the more they hate you and the heavier the damage you'll have to bear. How can you still be smiling...

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I just can't help feeling pleased to entrust them to you.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Before you arrived, I had my doubts about you. I thought you were an Outland Affairs Bureau agent coming to investigate the immigration and shut down this town. But then I saw how you got along with the people here, and how you showed more concern about Mania. Also, you tried to protect the townsfolk from the monsters.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So you've been testing me from the moment we met?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: And haven't you been doing the same, my little neighbor?
The Outland Affairs Bureau hasn't responded to your request. Nightingale's support will also take a while to arrive.
You can't let her bear all this new wave of Mania alone. The battle for Désir has only just begun.
[Town center]

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: You... you made us work here... kept telling me to wait, that my turn would come...

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I needed cheap labor. How else do you think my merchant caravan could've made my fortune?

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: What about those who already made it to DisCity?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: No one's ever made it. Not a single one. Your dear friend Sheila has turned into one of these monsters too.

steps.speaker: Juan
steps.content: So it's all just about the money, eh? Damn you, Vautour Bleu—I trusted you...!
[Dark alley]
All the surviving townsfolk are now within the safe zone. Outside, monsters continue gathering, their hungry eyes fixed on the town center, yet they're repelled by the final barrier of datura.
You can feel your strength ebbing away with overexertion, not knowing how much longer you can hold out.
If you survive this blast of resentment, come with us. I'll help clear up the misunderstanding, the hatred they have against you.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Come with you? Hehe, I've always been alone.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Alone on my balcony, whiling away the afternoons with my tea. I would watch those silly kids come by, clinging to scraps of hope. I made them promises, then watched them go.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Now, gladly someone can take over my job, so...

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: No worries. A poor reputation won't be much of a burden. I'm used to being alone.
Another newly spawned monster collapses under your shackles, cursing Vautour Bleu with its last agonizing cries.
[Town center]

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: So, from the moment you took us in... Was it all just a lie...?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Took you in? Wasn't it your own stubborn choice to follow me here and stay in Désir?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: The gates were always open. As long as you pay off your bills here, you're free to leave anytime. But no, you all clung to your laughable pipe dreams, that a better life is awaiting you.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: You call me a liar? You might as well point your finger at DisCity. Did you really think they'd let you in with the scraps you saved up? DisCity isn't some charity center for refugees.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: In fact, you'd be better off handing your money to me. After all, life in Désir wasn't so bad, was it?
Vautour Bleu's cavalier attitude has already pushed the near-hysterical townsfolk to the brink. Yet, she continues to fan the flames.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Oh, and where's Dove? You might ask her about those letters—about how she forged each one, feeding you lies of hope.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: The letters... Even those letters were fake...?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Correct. Désir is nothing but a woven lie, nothing more than a wasteland discarded by DisCity. I had my people remove the dead plants and planting new ones every day to maintain this so-called oasis. You all owe me.
The monsters' growls draw ever closer to the safe zone. The townsfolk watch in horror as the once-lush datura flowers die before their eyes.

steps.speaker: Juan
steps.content: Shameless! I shoulda never trusted you! Now it makes sense—that's why you kept raising the bar for my trip. Listen up, Vautour Bleu! If I'm gonna die for those monsters, I'm gonna take you down with me, you hear that?!
The riot spreads like wildfire. Scattered shouts of anger turn into deafening roars. The tools used to fend off monsters are now all aimed at Vautour Bleu.
[Dark alley]

You can't clear the Corruptors fast enough to catch up with the mounting waves of malice. These specters, consumed with resentment, seem to be drawn by the charged atmosphere in the town center. Growling, they brush past you, converging toward one direction.
Vautour Bleu's proposal is surely awful, yet it's the most pragmatic decision she could make as a merchant.
I can play along with you, but I can't promise DisCity will be on board.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: That's because they don't know what we're bringing to the table yet.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What do you mean... What's in it for DisCity?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: The assurance that the Outland Sinner Vautour Bleu is no longer a threat to their borders.
Beep, beep. Your communicator finally chimes. Backup is en route.
[Town center]
The enraged townsfolk are hurling clubs and stones. Spit, broken bottles, and rotten bread rain down on Vautour Bleu, accompanied by shrill screams and curses.
Yet she stands unmoved, enduring it all calmly, her gaze steady and fixed beyond the safe zone. At last, she spots the frail figure arriving with a support crew clad in white.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: The deal is done... Now, go be their beacon of hope. This is all I can do.

Standing on the ravaged street, Vautour Bleu raises her smoking pipe high above her head. Indigo power erupts from its tip, and in an instant, the last datura flowers in the safe zone wither and die. With the barrier gone, the monsters surge toward her in a frenzied wave.
People flee in terror, yet their bodies grow heavier with each step. The approaching creatures feed on their fear and despair, siphoning the last bit of strength from their agony.
As you arrive with the FAC reinforcements, the twisted, shadowy monsters have fused into a colossal entity. Its towering presence looms above, leaving you and the FAC soldiers frozen in shock.
It's the agglomeration of their obsessive dreams, shaped just like DisCity itself...

In the distance you spot her—the figure you've gazed at so many times from your window. But now she's no longer surrounded by her carefully tended plants, only a monstrous entity where she stands beneath, weary yet resolute. As you both agreed, she steps alone into the swirling vortex of Mania.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Don't let me down, little Chief.
